whisper.title: Speech recognition
whisper.subtitle: Whisper turns audio into text on your computer. Live Caption and Podcast use it.
whisper.notFoundDesc: Press the button to install it automatically.
whisper.chooseDesc: Bigger models are more accurate but slower and need more memory.
whisper.skippedNote: You can set up Whisper later in Settings.

models.tiny: Fastest model. Good for testing. Supports all languages.
models.base: Good balance of speed and accuracy. Supports all languages.
models.small: Better accuracy, moderate speed. Supports all languages.
models.large_v3_turbo: Best speed and accuracy balance. Recommended for most people.
models.large_v3_turbo_q5_0: Compact turbo model. Small and fast.

avx.title: This computer is not compatible with this build
avx.desc: Your processor does not support the AVX2 instructions the ready-made Whisper needs. This affects processors made before 2013 (Intel 3rd generation or older, early AMD).
avx.step1: Download a compatible build from whisper.cpp releases. Look for a noavx or compat build, or build it yourself with AVX2 turned off.
avx.step2: When it is installed, set its path in Settings, Whisper, Custom binary path.
avx.skipHint: Or skip for now and use the AI tutor and the other features. Transcription is only needed for Live Caption and Podcast.
